authority: owner decision OD-L1-10 (OWNER_DECISIONS_20261116.json): the capability answer must name what runs, and what cannot run is refused before any callback; golden files that record the old answer are re-pinned with a documented difference
frozen_before: any edit of crates/vigilode/src/capabilities.rs, solve.rs or error.rs for this node, and any run of its grid

defect.source: unified_frontend/REVIEW.json, finding R-01 (independent review of node V03 part A)
defect.statement: Rodas5p::capabilities gives a plan on the sequential dense route to a Jacobian::SparseJvp provider with a general (not banded) pattern when the request has a mass matrix, or dense output with InteriorError::Enforce. Rodas5p::solve then returns a driver error (a direct linear solver needs an explicit Jacobian), with 0 callbacks.
defect.size: 66 of 693 plans on the reviewer's grid at n = 4, and 352 distinct requests of the 9216 of the grid of crates/vigilode/tests/unified_frontend_contracts.rs; all 66 executed at n = 8 fail the same way

design: One decision function serves Rodas5p::capabilities and the validation of Rodas5p::solve: a request gets a plan only if the driver family the plan names runs it.

A request of the defect class is refused with a typed Unsupported reason before any callback. The builder finds by execution whether other request classes get a plan that cannot run, and treats each the same way; each class is listed in the results with its count.
No request that runs today is refused, and none gets another route.

discriminators.D1_truth_by_execution: on the request grid of unified_frontend_contracts.rs (9216 distinct requests) every plan is executed with real callbacks at n = 8 and runs on the planned driver family; every refusal makes 0 callbacks. Plans that cannot run: 0 (352 before the fix).
discriminators.D2_nothing_else_changes: before the fix (commit A) the route and, for every plan that runs, the step counts and a hash of the bits of the end state are recorded for the whole grid; after the fix (commit B) every request outside the refused classes has the same record.
discriminators.D3_golden: the default-path golden files change only in records of requests whose answer changes from a plan to a refusal; a script lists every changed record and the class it belongs to; no other byte of the golden files changes.
discriminators.D4_consumers: the registry and the unified router (nodes V03 part A and part B) still agree with Rodas5p::capabilities (their tests pass); the facade suite passes; clippy and rustfmt are clean.

verdicts.FAIL: any discriminator fails: the fix is not merged and the defect stays listed for the owner

not_changed: which driver runs any request that runs today, and its bits
